title: Kontrakt kont: User, Account, AccountMember, accountId w raporcie, API-007…API-013
description: Dopisz do contracts/data_model.json DM-016 User (email unikalny, passwordHash, name, createdAt), DM-017 Account (name, createdAt), DM-018 AccountMember (accountId, userId|null, email, status active|pending, addedBy, createdAt; unikalne accountId+email) i pole accountId (opcjonalne) w DM-001 Report. Do contracts/api.json: API-007 POST /auth/register {email,password,name} → {token,user,accounts}; API-008 POST /auth/login → {token,user,accounts}; API-009 GET /me (auth) → {user,accounts[]}; API-010 GET /accounts/:id/members (auth, członek); API-011 POST /accounts/:id/members {email} → member active|pending; API-012 DELETE /accounts/:id/members/:memberId (409 LAST_MEMBER); API-013 GET /accounts/:id/reports (paginacja {items,page,pageSize,total}); POST /analyses (API-004) z opcjonalnym accountId przy Bearer. Kody: UNAUTHORIZED 401, FORBIDDEN 403, EMAIL_TAKEN 409, INVALID_CREDENTIALS 401, LAST_MEMBER 409, examples dla każdego. Wg docs/adr/ADR-010-shared-accounts.md.
